name: nulllab
description: NULLLAB — practice over theory. Open-source, self-hosted web application security lab platform.

scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/lab-sdk && npm run build -w @nulllab/orchestrator
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:libs && vitest run tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:libs && vitest run tests/integration
scripts.test:proxy: npm run build:libs && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('proxy-report',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vitest run -c vitest.proxy.config.ts && tsx scripts/check-proxy-status.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
